collection.description: A chief wears unusually elaborate clothing to a modest gathering, and villagers whisper about it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A {@chief} wears unusually elaborate clothing to a modest gathering, and villagers whisper about it.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The outfit honors a family milestone.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The {@chief} admits they simply enjoy dressing up.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The garments are safely stored during rain.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Villagers reconsider their assumptions about status.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (critic), a critic, expresses concern about public resources.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Others arrive in their favorite clothes.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The {@chief} discovers they are no longer the best dressed.
